title: Affine ideal-product intersection comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F,G$ quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $g:G\hookrightarrow F$ a monomorphism, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $U$ an affine open. Write $R=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $M=F(U)$, $J=I(U)$, and $N=\operatorname{im}(g(U))\subseteq M$. Products, powers including $I^0=\mathcal O_X$, and sectionwise intersections are as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $c,n\ge0$. If $J^nM\cap N=J^{n-c}(J^cM\cap N)$, where $n-c$ is truncated subtraction, then on every open $W\subseteq U$ the images in $F(W)$ satisfy $(I^{n-c}(I^c F\cap G))(W)=(I^nF)(W)\cap\operatorname{im}(g(W))$. No Noetherian or finite-type assumption is imposed.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Tag 01YA (lemma-Artin-Rees), affine reduction in the proof, expanded using Schemes Tags 01I8 and 01IC. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YA because the literature checkout is absent on this machine.

proof.text: Use the existing affine ideal-product theorem to obtain quasi-coherence and section ranges of all positive powers, and handle exponent zero directly using the structure module and its identity inclusion. For an arbitrary quasi-coherent ideal module K mapping to O_X, the affine tensor comparison and the affine image formula compute the multiplication image as range(K(U) -> O_X(U)) times M(U). Tensor induction proves both inclusions. This gives quasi-coherence and the affine section formula for I^t M, including t=0. For product quasi-coherence, use the public quasiCoherent_cokernel_image image clause for the tensor multiplication morphism and transport along Abelian.imageIsoImage; no duplicate product_qc theorem is stated.

For each t, form H_t as the pullback of I^t F -> F and g:G -> F. The pullback is the kernel of (p_t,-g): I^t F direct-sum G -> F, so binary direct sums and kernels make it quasi-coherent. Evaluation followed by the forgetful functor to types preserves the pullback. Compatible pairs of sections therefore show on every open W that the composite H_t -> F has range range(p_t(W)) intersect range(g(W)). Both product inclusions and these pullback inclusions are monomorphisms.

Apply the arbitrary-ideal-module affine multiplication formula from the first step to I^(n-c) H_c. Map its section range through the inclusion H_c -> F. LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.map_smul, and Submodule.map_top give I(U)^(n-c) times the intersection I(U)^c F(U) intersect image(g(U)). The hypothesis hmodule identifies this range with the range of H_n -> F on U.

Prove affine range inclusion detection for a map i:A -> F with A quasi-coherent and a monomorphism j:B -> F. The range inclusion on U says i followed by cokernel(j) vanishes on U. On a basic open D(f) inside U, every section of A is the restriction of a section over U after multiplication by a power of f. Naturality and the unit property of f on D(f) force the composite to vanish on D(f). Basic opens cover every W contained in U, and sheaf separatedness forces the composite to vanish on W. Evaluation preserves kernels, so its vanishing puts i(W) in the section range of kernel(cokernel(j)); the abelian image factorization of the monomorphism j is an isomorphism, giving a preimage in B(W). Apply this argument in both directions to I^(n-c) H_c -> F and H_n -> F, whose sources are quasi-coherent, and finish with the pullback range calculation. No compactness or positivity condition is used.

proof_origin.based_on: Stacks 01YA affine reduction, 01I8 tensor comparison and 01IC quasi-coherent kernels/images. The compiled proof uses the existing basic-open denominator lemma instead of constructing an isomorphism via tilde/global sections; all local helpers are proved. Repair: removed the duplicate product_qc helper, using the existing public cokernel/image theorem directly at both required products; the existing product_qc is private and cannot be referenced by importers.

theorem artin_rees_affine_comparison {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (g : G ⟶ F) [Mono g] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) (c n : ℕ)
    (hmodule : I.ideal U ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule Γ(X, U.1) Γ(F, U.1)) ⊓
        LinearMap.range (g.val.app (.op U.1)).hom =
      I.ideal U ^ (n - c) • (I.ideal U ^ c •
        (⊤ : Submodule Γ(X, U.1) Γ(F, U.1)) ⊓
          LinearMap.range (g.val.app (.op U.1)).hom)) :
    ∀ W : X.Opens, W ≤ U.1 →
      Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (n - c)).2
        (pullback (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι c).2 F) g) ≫
          pullback.fst (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι c).2 F) g ≫
            idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι c).2 F).app W) =
        Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 F).app W) ∩
          Set.range (g.app W)
